head: mi140-alpaca-live-refusal-verdict
title: MI-140 (T-7): alpaca_live is not failing to place orders — it was asked twice, both times to short
body:
Opened by the manager via the `pr-opener` relay: the authoring session (MI-140) had this branch ready at `37d3ed41` and was BLOCKED for ~80 minutes on a GitHub App 403 for PR creation. The relay is the documented path for exactly that 403.

**Verdict: correctly refusing — and the declaration is correct too.** The T-7 premise (*"every signal journals `dry_run_no_order_placed`"*) is true over a population of **two**, and misleading at that size. Since the roster was armed 2026-08-31 `alpaca_live` has received 2 signals (trades n=2; independently order_packages n=2, so no long signal was generated and lost). Both were `tlt_pullback_1h` SHORT on TLT, both sized 2.0 whole shares, both suppressed by the operator-directed `side_filter: long` gate — which folds into `effective_dry` by design and journals exactly that token.

⚠️ **The order path is UNTESTED, not inert** — zero long signals have reached it. Recorded as could-not-establish rather than written up as either working or broken.

**Four of five leads ruled OUT on evidence, one ruled IN:**

| lead | disposition |
|---|---|
| cash-settlement gate | RULED OUT — 0 of 27 soak rows are `alpaca_live` across the whole armed window; the gate sits behind the same `effective_dry` short-circuit and never evaluated |
| `dry_run_sizing_skip` | RULED OUT — all 161 occurrences are pre-arm, 0 post-arm |
| `balance()` returning None | RULED OUT — `balance()=200.22` logged live twice today; broker reads ACTIVE |
| whole-share sizing | RULED OUT — 1 share risks $0.345 against a $4.00 budget, fits 11.6×; cash clamps to 2 shares, reproducing the journalled 2.0 |
| **`silent_refusal_alert`** | **RULED IN — the real defect.** Its latch is frozen at 2026-08-21, ten days pre-arming, still reporting `alerting`/`signalled_never_placed`/`risk_refused` with no `alert_disposition` key at all. Likely the source of the framing this task inherited. |

**No Tier-3 diff is warranted** — nothing on the order path, sizing, risk caps or the account mode is defective. The one real defect is in the alerting layer and is proposed, not applied; its fix depends on a live `SILENT_REFUSAL_SKIP` read this session could not make, and that gap is stated rather than papered over.
